segments.caption: Two pairs of male badminton players are competing in a doubles match on an indoor court. The players in yellow are returning the shuttlecock to the players in red. The match is being played intensely with the players moving around the court.

Two male badminton players in yellow shirts hit the shuttlecock back and forth with their opponents in red shirts on a court. The players in yellow are celebrating a point at the end. The match is taking place on a badminton court.
A young woman is performing a gymnastics routine on a basketball court. She is standing and appears to be preparing for a tumbling pass. The event is taking place at the University of South Florida.

A young boy is jumping rope on a basketball court. He is wearing a red shirt and black shorts, and is holding a green jump rope in each hand. The boy jumps rope while moving across the court.

A man is running across a basketball court. He is wearing a red shirt and black shorts. The man is participating in a tournament, as indicated by the banner reading "World Jump Rope Tournament 2012" in the background.

A woman is holding a pink Nike shoe and an orange shoe box. She is comparing the shoe to the box. The scene is likely a product review or unboxing.

A young man performs a dive into an indoor swimming pool. He jumps from a diving board, flips in the air, and enters the water, creating a splash. The scene is observed by several people seated along the wall.

A man practices hitting a ball with a hurley stick on a sports field. He is wearing a white and blue uniform, blue socks, and a red helmet, and is repeatedly swinging the stick to hit the ball. The scene is set in a stadium with advertisements and empty stands in the background.

A group of young men are raking leaves in a yard, while a young boy walks along a path. The men are using rakes to gather leaves into a pile. The scene is set in a residential neighborhood with houses and trees visible in the background.

A young boy and a man are raking leaves into a trash can in a residential driveway. The man is holding a rake and appears to be guiding the boy, who is crouched down beside the trash can. They are working together to clean up the fallen leaves from the yard.
A group of children are raking leaves in a yard with a white picket fence.
A man and three children are sitting in the back of a car parked on the side of a road.

A man is working out on a treadmill in a gym. He is wearing a black tank top and appears to be running.
